text: I'd like you to make an audio intro for my podcast, Small Wonders. I've been looking forward to giving the show a proper introduction, and I'm a little nervous about how it will come across. What I have in mind is a 20-second intro with a warm female voice saying, “Welcome to Small Wonders, the show about big ideas hiding in everyday life. I'm Maya. Let's get curious.” Please put upbeat, gentle electronic music underneath, include a little music-only opening and a smooth fade at the end, and give me one finished audio file.
